entities.summary: Andrii Volodymyrovych Portnov is a Ukrainian historian, essayist, and editor. In 2018–2025 he was the chair professor of entangled history of Ukraine at the European University Viadrina in Frankfurt (Oder).. Portnov is a director of the PRISMA UKRAЇNA Research Network Eastern Europe. He specializes in Polish-Russian-Ukrainian history and memory studies.
